public_source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API, hourly CERRA wind_speed_100m, UTC m/s
fixed_weather_admission: >=1050 20+ finite hourly wind calendar days from 2019-01-01 through 2021-12-31
data_quality_diagnosis: The CERRA public service returns entirely null hourly wind_speed_100m for 2021 July-Dec, despite returning UTC hourly timestamps; this—not missing GPS altitude or biological effect—caused the run to fail preheight.
no_rescue: Original CERRA study remains source-unavailable. Do not simply relax 1050 to 912 days or silently restrict the 2021 calendar window.
separate_research_option: Create a distinct version-locked exploratory source-weather analysis with globally available ERA5 hourly 100m winds covering all 1,096 days, with its coarser grid and separate source/study declaration. Never present it as the same CERRA resolution or an independent biological sample.
